We report the average of a variety of metrics: top1, top5 accuracy and MRR (metrics description in Section A.3).

We employed 3 annotators with a background in NLP and Social Sciences... The annotators were tasked to classify each of the candidates with one of the following labels: BEST PARENT (count 1), SUITABLE PARENT (max. 4), or LESS SUITABLE PARENT.
guideline: The goal of this task is to find comment pairs that are most likely to have the relationship "parent-child" in an argument setting. More specifically, given a target comment (child), you must select the most likely parent of this comment from a list of candidates, aka, what the given comment is in response to.
